channel.title: The Journal of Clinical Psychiatry - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Journal of Clinical Psychiatry (psychiatrist.com)

item.title: What Clinicians Should Know About Alzheimer’s Treatment with Marc Agronin, MD
item.description: Dr. Marc Agronin covers early Alzheimer

item.title: Between Crisis and Clarity: Steroid-Induced Psychosis in Addison Disease
item.description: This case highlights a rare but clinically significant dilemma: balancing essential corticosteroid replacement against neuropsychiatric toxicity.

item.title: Health Belief Model and Treatment Adherence in Patients With Dissociative Disorders: A Cross-Sectional Study
item.description: This study examined how health belief model constructs influence treatment adherence among patients with dissociative disorders and how demographic variables influence that relationship.

item.title: Mania as a Symptom of Hypertensive Emergency in Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy
item.description: This report details a case in which a patient presented with mania in the setting of cerebral amyloid angiopathy and hypertension that did not abate until treatment with antihypertensives.

item.title: An Atypical Presentation of Autoimmune Encephalitis
item.description: A 23-year-old woman presented with probable antibody-negative autoimmune encephalitis that initially mimicked a primary psychiatric disorder.

item.title: Recreational Ketamine-Induced Uropathy: Recognition and Management in Primary Care and Psychiatric Practice
item.description: Two patients with chronic recreational ketamine use presented with urinary frequency, urgency, dysuria, and hematuria in the absence of infection.

item.title: Vitamin B12 Deficiency Risk During Metformin Treatment for Weight Management in Second-Generation Antipsychotic Recipients: Reply to Mulsant et al
item.description: Daggolu and Chen reply to a letter commenting on their study of metformin use in patients receiving second-generation antipsychotics.

item.title: Concurrent Metformin and Second-Generation Antipsychotics: The Need to Add Vitamin B12
item.description: The authors recommend vigilance for potential B12 deficiency when coprescribing metformin and antipsychotics.

item.title: Association of Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor and Other Antidepressant Drugs With Dental Implant Failure
item.description: Antidepressant users should be educated about the risk of dental implant failure, and efforts should be made to identify and negate other risk factors for implant failure.

item.title: Tacrolimus-Induced Parasomnia Posttransplantation
item.description: The authors present a rare case of tacrolimus-induced parasomnia, adding to the body of evidence on its neurotoxic potential.
